result.stderr:
b4-roslyn — ByteAid Roslyn MCP server for .NET solutions

Usage:
  b4-roslyn start [options]      (or via the family dispatcher: b4 roslyn start)

Starts the MCP server (stdio transport), rooted at the current working
directory. If --solution is omitted, the single .sln/.slnx file at the
root level is used; with zero or multiple candidates the command fails
and asks for an explicit --solution.

Options:
  -s, --solution <path>   Solution file to load (absolute or relative to the root).
      --root <path>       Working root (defaults to the current directory).
  -h, --help              Show this help.
